name: Slider
description: Picks a number, or a range with two thumbs, by dragging along a track. Shows the formatted value.

label.description: Visible label, also the accessible name.

step.description: Amount each arrow key press changes the value by.

value.description: Controlled value. An array of two numbers makes a range slider.

defaultValue.description: Initial value when uncontrolled. An array of two numbers makes a range slider.

formatOptions.description: How the value is shown and announced, e.g. { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }.

showValue.description: Shows the formatted value next to the label.

isDisabled.description: Prevents interaction and dims the slider.

onChange.description: Called continuously while the value changes.

onChangeEnd.description: Called once when the user finishes, e.g. to run a search.

keyboard: Left/Down Arrow decreases by one step; Right/Up Arrow increases
Page Up/Page Down change by a larger step
Home and End jump to the minimum and maximum
requirements: Each thumb is a native range input, labelled by the slider's label (range thumbs say minimum or maximum)
The value text uses formatOptions, so screen readers hear $250, not 250
Range thumbs can't cross each other
The thumb is at least 24px, for touch
screenReader: Each thumb is announced as a slider with the label and formatted value
Arrow keys announce each new value
In a range, thumbs are announced as the minimum and maximum of the label

use_when: An approximate value in a known range, like price or volume
Filters where the exact number matters less than the feel
avoid_when: Exact values: use a number TextField
Very large ranges where a step is meaningless
anti_patterns: Hiding the value: show it, so users know where they are
A slider as the only way to enter a precise number
